what.title: What is gout? Prevalence, the four stages and where flares strike
what.description: Gout is a disease of urate crystals: how common it is by survey, records and model, the A–D stages, and which joints it hits first.

urate.title: Where uric acid comes from: purines, xanthine oxidase, kidney and gut
urate.description: How purines become urate, why humans lack uricase, how URAT1, GLUT9 and ABCG2 handle urate, and why most gout is under-excretion.

crystals.title: Gout crystals vs serum urate: saturation, deposition, dissolving
crystals.description: How urate crystals form above 6.8 mg/dL, grow silently for years and dissolve when urate-lowering therapy keeps serum urate below 6 mg/dL.

flare.title: Gout flare hour by hour: crystals, NLRP3, IL-1β and neutrophils
flare.description: Animated gout flare: urate crystals trigger NLRP3 and IL-1β, neutrophils flood the joint, NETs end it within 14 days. Where colchicine and other drugs act.

colin.title: How colchicine works in gout: from pill to NLRP3
colin.description: Animated: colchicine absorbed, trapped in white cells, binding tubulin, and why NLRP3 needs microtubules to fire after a urate crystal. Cited.

flarerx.title: Gout flare treatment: colchicine, NSAIDs, steroids, IL-1
flarerx.description: Why early treatment helps, AGREE low-dose colchicine, CONTACT, prednisolone vs NSAIDs, IL-1 blockers, ice, and choosing by comorbidity.

coldose.title: Colchicine dosing, interactions and toxicity in gout
coldose.description: Published gout colchicine doses, CYP3A4/P-gp interactions (clarithromycin, ritonavir), kidney and dialysis rules, and toxicity. Cited, not advice.

ult.title: How urate-lowering drugs work: allopurinol, febuxostat, uricase
ult.description: Allopurinol and febuxostat make less urate, probenecid and URAT1 drugs excrete more, pegloticase breaks it down. Animated pathway, half-lives, approvals.

t2t.title: Treat to target in gout: allopurinol titration and flare prophylaxis
t2t.description: Start low, raise allopurinol every few weeks until urate is below 6 mg/dL, and cover early flares. A two-year simulator with Doherty 2018 trial data.

ultsafety.title: Allopurinol and febuxostat safety: HLA-B*58:01, CARES vs FAST
ultsafety.description: Allopurinol hypersensitivity and HLA-B*58:01 testing, the starting-dose rule, febuxostat heart trials CARES and FAST, interactions and pegloticase rules.

dx.title: Gout diagnosis: crystals, ACR/EULAR 2015 calculator, imaging
dx.description: Score the 2015 ACR/EULAR gout criteria live, see urate vs CPP crystals under polarised light, and compare ultrasound, DECT and X-ray. Cited.

ddx.title: Gout differential: septic arthritis, CPPD, cellulitis compared
ddx.description: Gout vs septic arthritis, CPP crystal arthritis, cellulitis, RA, PsA and OA side by side, with red flags and joint-fluid white-count likelihood ratios.

links.title: Gout, kidney disease and heart disease: the links and the trials
links.description: How gout links to CKD, kidney stones, blood pressure and heart disease, which links are causal, and what CKD-FIX, ALL-HEART and the colchicine trials show.

living.title: Living with gout: diet, alcohol, weight, medicines, flare plans
living.description: How much diet, alcohol and weight really move urate, flare triggers, medicines that raise urate, ACR 2020 advice, surgery, pregnancy and monitoring.

nursing.title: Gout nursing care: assessment, medicines and treat to target
nursing.description: How nurses assess a gout flare, give colchicine, allopurinol and pegloticase safely, teach, and run nurse-led treat-to-target care. Cited.

cure.title: Can gout be cured? Crystal clearance and the new gout drugs
cure.description: Gout is curable by dissolving urate crystals. Remission data and the pipeline (dotinurad, tigulixostat, uricase, NLRP3, IL-1) with evidence labels.

history.title: History of gout: podagra to allopurinol and the inflammasome
history.description: Gout from Hippocrates' podagra to van Leeuwenhoek's crystals, Garrod's thread test, polarised light, allopurinol and NLRP3: an animated, cited timeline.

review.title: Gout flashcards and mnemonics: urate, flares, ULT, diagnosis
review.description: 68 gout flashcards with short, exact answers across six parts, plus eight sourced memory aids such as Six for gout and Negative Needle, Positive rhomboid.

quiz.title: Gout quiz: 58 questions with cited explanations
quiz.description: Test yourself on urate, crystals, flare treatment, colchicine, urate-lowering drugs, diagnosis and history. Mixed 20-question rounds or one part at a time.

glossary.title: Gout glossary: 88 terms from ABCG2 to xanthine oxidase
glossary.description: Searchable definitions of gout terms, from urate transporters and the NLRP3 inflammasome to HLA-B*58:01, DECT and remission, each linked to its module.

sources.title: Sources and references | Gout Companion
sources.description: Every reference behind the gout guide, validated against PubMed, Europe PMC, Crossref, ClinicalTrials.gov and drug labels in October 2026. Searchable by area.
